title: Steamed Bao with Turkey and Ham
description: A delicious and easy-to-make steamed bao filled with juicy turkey and ham. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Bao buns
ingredients.notes: You can find these in most Asian grocery stores or online.

ingredients.name: Steamed vegetables
ingredients.notes: Your choice of crunchy veggies, such as carrots and bell peppers.

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together soy sauce and sesame oil. Set aside.
Cut the bao buns in half and place on a baking sheet.
Steam the bao buns for 5-7 minutes, or according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat the sliced turkey and ham over medium heat until warmed through.
Add the steamed vegetables to the pan and stir to combine.
Spoon the turkey and vegetable mixture onto the steamed bao buns.
Drizzle the soy sauce mixture over the top and sprinkle with green onions.
